column1: # Measured duration of each Go runtime test, for scripts/ci/go-test-shard.sh.
# Weights only: missing/stale entries affect balance, never test membership.
# Source: CI run 41947800828, race shards of integration-postgres{,-2}.
# Top-level PASS/SKIP elapsed seconds only; the earlier non-race Postgres smoke
# is excluded. Package paths are matched to unique current test declarations.
# Observed tests >= 0.5 s and prior tracked keys are refreshed; refreshed short
# tests use a 0.1 s floor. Unobserved prior weights are retained unchanged.
